Original Japanese order of the same books: The Honjin Murders (1946), Death on Gokumon Island (1947), Murder at the Black Cat Cafe (title story 1947; the volume adds 'Why Did the Well Wheel Creak?', 1949/1955), She Walks at Night (1948), The Village of Eight Graves (1949), The Inugami Curse (1950), [The Queen Bee Mystery (1951)], The Devil's Flute Murders (1951), The Little Sparrow Murders (1957). Each book is a stand-alone case. Pushkin's label is 'Detective Kindaichi Mysteries' if she prefers that name.
